mapper.select: SELECT ts.id, ts.step_instance_id AS stepInstanceId, ts.status, ts.enqueue_seq AS enqueueSeq, t.id AS taskId, t.queue_id AS queueId, t.priority AS priority FROM task_step ts JOIN task t ON t.id = ts.task_id WHERE ts.status = 'RETRYING' AND ts.next_retry_at <= now() AND t.deleted = false ORDER BY ts.next_retry_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_step_retry (task_step_id, attempt_no, status, machine_ip, exit_code, fail_reason) VALUES (#{taskStepId}, #{attemptNo}, #{status}, #{machineIp}, #{exitCode}, #{failReason})
